method: Exact FLINT Rabin certification of X^p+aX^3+bX^2+cX+d over every odd prime p<1500 and all 5,832 integral cubic tails with nonzero cubic coefficient and coefficient height at most 4.
notes: The p=5 case is affected by the known small-characteristic leading/cubic collision and is excluded from the nondegenerate failure count.
Every listed nondegenerate uncovered prime exhausts all 5,832 height-4 tails with no irreducible polynomial.
Primes listed in the original phase1_failures field but not here had one or two witnesses rather than the requested three; they are not failures of existence.
